purpose: Regulatory sell-side fees and the IBKR Pro tiered commission used by protocol.json costs.fees, taken from primary sources and dated. Rates apply on the trade date (the SEC text uses charge dates; the difference of a settlement cycle at a boundary is ignored and recorded here). Brokers round each fee up to the cent per trade; this model does not round.

sec_section31_usd_per_million_of_sales.quote: each SRO will continue to pay the Commission a rate of $22.10 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates through February 24, 2021, and a rate of $5.10 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates on or after February 25, 2021.

each SRO will continue to pay the Commission a rate of $5.10 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates through May 13, 2022, and a rate of $22.90 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates on or after May 14, 2022.

each self-regulatory organization will continue to pay the Commission a rate of $22.90 per million dollars for covered sales occurring on charge dates through February 26, 2023, and a rate of $8.00 per million dollars for covered sales occurring on charge dates on or after February 27, 2023.

each self-regulatory organization will continue to pay the Commission a rate of $8 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates through May 21, 2024, and a rate of $27.80 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates on or after May 22, 2024.

each SRO will continue to pay the Commission a rate of $27.80 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates through May 13, 2025, and a rate of $0.00 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates on or after May 14, 2025.

each SRO will continue to pay the Commission a rate of $0.00 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates through April 3, 2026, and a rate of $20.60 per million for covered sales occurring on charge dates on or after April 4, 2026.
starting on April 4, 2026, the fee rates applicable to most securities transactions will be set at $20.60 per million dollars.
